explanation: The statement is correct: since C(x) ≤ x, C(x) = x^{1-o(1)} is equivalent to log C(x) / log x → 1. IsCarmichael is the standard definition (b^n ≡ b mod n for all b coprime to n, via FermatPsp, which excludes primes). However, erdosproblems.com/1057 now says 'a formal proof that C(x)=x^{1-o(1)} is available' (github.com/JENW1N/erdos1057-lean, created October 2026, crediting Kohlmeyer, Kruer, Howe and Huffman). The `research open` category therefore appears outdated, though the page shows no explicit status badge. The status should be rechecked and the formal_proof link added if the proof holds up.
